pairs.l: 1 — laptops should be used as an additional learning tool?
2 — getting rid of textbooks would change teaching methods?
3 — despite being heavy, textbooks are still useful?
4 — the budget for laptop maintenance is bigger than for textbooks?
5 — too much time on laptops can cause health issues?
6 — children will need help to stay focused while working with laptops?
7 — the use of laptops could result in withdrawal from peers?
8 — the traditional approach to learning will die out?
9 — finding information in a textbook can be quicker than on a laptop?
10 — getting rid of textbooks would disadvantage some students?
12 — you cannot always depend on laptops?

r1.exp: 1=B (Bradley: 'laptops would make wonderful SUPPLEMENTS'). 2=D (Dominic: 'Education will IRREVOCABLY CHANGE... teachers will need FURTHER TRAINING'). 3=F (Forrest: 'they may well have a point even if they are generally written to match the students' reading ability'). 4=F (Forrest: 'the benefits of quick updates are CANCELLED OUT by the cost of maintaining networks'). 5=A (Annabelle: 'students overusing them can result in various types of INJURIES... withdrawal symptoms'). 6=E (Elaine: 'some tools should be used to MINIMISE students' attention being DIVERTED by online distractions'). 7=E (Elaine: 'online homework might REDUCE THE NEED TO SOCIALISE with classmates'). 8=D (Dominic: 'This digital revolution... CANNOT BE TURNED BACK'). 9=F (Forrest: 'sometimes it is a lot simpler than logging on, searching for the appropriate link'). 10=C (Cheryl: 'tossing books away would help one group of students while HINDERING ANOTHER'). 11=D (Dominic: 'the parents should be the ones to PURCHASE them'). 12=B (Bradley: 'laptops have their limits, such as when there is a POWER CUT, while a BOOK CAN ALWAYS BE OPENED').

r19.exp: 'Population speaks at least 153 languages. (19)____. The true figure could be even higher.' → F: This fact makes it one of the world's most diverse places linguistically.

r20.exp: 'On top of the list due to many factors. (20)____. As THEY continue flowing in, list set to grow.' → B: The most important ones are immigration and the arrival of overseas students to the city. 'They' = immigrants/students.

r21.exp: 'Two-thirds of schoolchildren are bilingual. (21)____. And there are rare languages.' → H: This HUGE RATIO indicates just how DEEPLY ROOTED and FIRMLY ESTABLISHED its linguistic culture is.

r22.exp: 'Melbourne is famous for its many languages. (22)____. New York is larger and has attracted immigrants just as long.' → D: However, it is still LESS DIVERSE than Manchester as it tends to have very ESTABLISHED COMMUNITIES.

r23.exp: 'Foreign-born population increasing. (23)____. Miliband said everyone should speak English.' → A: This has consequently PROMPTED CONCERNS about ASSIMILATION.

r24.exp: 'Matras's research suggests something else about the census. (24)____. And it is still growing.' → C: It may have substantially UNDERESTIMATED the number of multilingual households across the UK.

r25.exp: 'On a DAILY basis' — fiksna kolokacija: on a daily basis = svakodnevno.

r26.exp: 'Hair messy and comical. HOWEVER, beneath this was the most dogged investigator.' — 'however' za kontrast.

r27.exp: 'Was often CALLED ON to investigate' — frazalni glagol: call on = pozvati, angažirati nekoga.

r28.exp: 'He WOULD move towards the door' — 'would' za uobičajenu prošlu radnju (habitually did).

r29.exp: 'They were sure he wouldn't BE ASKING' — wouldn't + be asking (negative future continuous za nešto što ne očekuju da će se postaviti).

r30.exp: 'They'll GET AWAY with their crime' — frazalni glagol: get away with = proći nekažnjeno.

r31.exp: 'His wife PLAYED a very important role' — fiksna kolokacija: play a role = igrati ulogu.

r32.exp: 'Things his wife HAD told him' — past perfect u indirektnom govoru (pluperfect za radnju u daljnjoj prošlosti).

r33.exp: 'In the event OF a great natural disaster' — fiksni izraz: in the event of = u slučaju.

r34.exp: 'Drastic ones SUCH as asteroids' — fiksni izraz: such as = poput, na primjer.

r35.exp: 'Never exceeds minus four EVEN if there's a power cut' — 'even if' = čak i ako; ili 'except if' = osim ako.

r36.exp: 'Power cuts DID actually occur' — 'did' za naglasak/emfazu u pozitivnoj rečenici (emphasising that it really happened).

r37.exp: 'Many of WHICH are not in general use' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (odnosi se na varieties).

r38.exp: 'The seed collections they are PART of' — fiksna kolokacija: be part of = biti dio nečega.

r39.exp: 'New strains FOR whatever challenges in the future' — prijedlog 'for' za namjenu (strains to meet/handle challenges).

r40.exp: 'Think about crop diversity AS something important' — 'as' za identifikaciju/svrhu; ili 'being something important'.
